scripts.build: cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); try { fs.cpSync(path.join(__dirname, '../frontend/dist'), path.join(__dirname, 'dist'), {recursive: true}); console.log('Frontend build copied successfully'); } catch(e) { console.log('Copy failed:', e.message); }"
